## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new `CRITERION_HINT` should be fixed: it tells users to omit "shall", which the retained `require_shall=True` option rejects.

## Changes
The pull request rewords the two user-facing hint strings in `app/criteria.py` and adds a one-line `review.txt` at the repository root. The validator `accepts_criterion` and its tests are unchanged.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/criteria.py:1 — correctness — Hint forbids "shall" that `require_shall=True` demands — With `require_shall=True`, a criterion written as the new hint directs, such as `- Save the result`, is rejected. The hint says "without the word shall", while `accepts_criterion` returns `" shall " in text` at `app/criteria.py:8`. — Users of a configuration that enables `require_shall` follow the hint and have their criteria rejected, with no text pointing to the cause. — Fix: Either drop the "without the word shall" clause or choose the hint text from the `require_shall` setting.
